),

f.marketIndex, 
f.indexTime, 
f.tradingdate,

-- Tham số đầu vào :p_from, :p_to YYYYMM
WITH params AS (
SELECT
TO_DATE(:p_from || '01', 'YYYYMMDD') AS from_date,
LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(:p_to || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')) AS to_date
FROM DUAL
),
-- Lọc toàn bộ dữ liệu trong khoảng tháng truyền vào
filtered AS (
SELECT
m.marketId,
m.marketCode,
m.marketIndex,
m.indexTime,
m.tradingdate,
TO_DATE(m.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS td_date
FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR m, params p
WHERE TO_DATE(m.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
BETWEEN p.from_date AND p.to_date
),
-- Xác định ngày giao dịch cuối cùng trong mỗi tháng
last_trading_day_per_month AS (
SELECT
TO_CHAR(td_date, 'YYYYMM') AS yyyymm,
MAX(td_date) AS last_td_date
FROM filtered
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(td_date, 'YYYYMM')
),
-- Lấy bản ghi cuối cùng (indexTime MAX) trong ngày cuối tháng, theo từng marketId + marketCode
ranked AS (
SELECT
f.marketId,
f.marketCode,
f.marketIndex,
f.indexTime,
f.tradingdate,
l.yyyymm,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
PARTITION BY f.marketId, f.marketCode, l.yyyymm
ORDER BY f.indexTime DESC
) AS rn
FROM filtered f
JOIN last_trading_day_per_month l
ON f.td_date = l.last_td_date
)
SELECT
yyyymm AS period,
tradingdate,
marketId,
marketCode,
marketIndex,
indexTime
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY yyyymm, marketId, marketCode;

SELECT 
ROWNUM AS stt, 
inv."Name" AS ho_ten_ndt, 
inv."EName" AS ho_ten_ndt_en, 
CASE inv."ObjectType" WHEN 1 THEN 'Ca nhan' 
WHEN 2 THEN 'To chuc' END AS loai_hinh, 
inv."TransactionCode" AS ma_so_giao_dich, 
nat."Name" AS quoc_tich, 
inv."Address" AS dia_chi, 
tr."FULLNAME" AS ten_dai_dien_gd, 
it."Name" AS loai_hinh_ndt_to_chuc, 
cs."SecId" AS ma_chung_khoan, 
cs."Quantity" AS so_luong_so_huu, 
cs."Rate" AS ty_le_so_huu_pct 
FROM FIMS_NEW.INVESTOR inv 
LEFT JOIN FIMS_NEW.NATIONAL nat ON nat."Id" = inv."NaId" AND nat."Deleted" = 0 
LEFT JOIN FIMS_NEW.INVESTORTYPE it ON it."Id" = inv."InvestorTypeId" AND it."Deleted" = 0 
LEFT JOIN FIMS_NEW.CATEGORIESSTOCK cs ON cs."InvesId" = inv."Id" AND cs."Deleted" = 0 
LEFT JOIN FIMS_NEW.TRADINGAUTHORIZATION ta ON ta."InvestorId" = inv."Id" AND ta."Deleted" = 0 
LEFT JOIN FIMS_NEW.TRADINGREPRESENTATIVE tr ON tr."ID" = ta."TradingRepresentativeId" AND tr."DELETED" = 0 
WHERE inv."Deleted" = 0 
ORDER BY inv."Id", cs."SecId";
